requirement: As a user, I want to add an item to my shopping list so that I can track things I need to buy.

test_cases.title: Add a new item with all fields populated
preconditions: User is logged in with a valid account
At least one category already exists

steps.action: Navigate to an existing category and click "+ Add item"
steps.expected_result: An item creation form opens with empty fields

steps.action: Enter the item name, brand, unit price, and quantity from the test data
steps.expected_result: Each field accepts and displays the entered value without error

steps.action: Click "Save item"
steps.expected_result: The form closes and the new item appears in the category's item list

steps.action: Verify the item row's displayed values
steps.expected_result: Name, brand, unit price, and calculated total price match the values entered in step 2

postconditions: The new item persists after refreshing the page

requirement: As a user, I want to edit an existing item's price so that my spending totals stay accurate.

test_cases.title: Edit an item's unit price and confirm totals update
preconditions: An item already exists with a known unit price and quantity

steps.action: Locate the target item in its category's item list
steps.expected_result: The item's current unit price and total price are visible and match test data

steps.action: Click the edit icon on the item's row
steps.expected_result: An edit form opens pre-populated with the item's current values

steps.action: Clear the unit price field and enter the new value from test data
steps.expected_result: The field accepts the new numeric value

steps.action: Click "Save"
steps.expected_result: The form closes and the item row reflects the new unit price

steps.action: Verify the item's total price (unit price x quantity)
steps.expected_result: Total price recalculates correctly based on the new unit price

postconditions: The updated price persists after refreshing the page

requirement: As a user, I want to delete an item from my list so that I can remove things I no longer need.

test_cases.title: Delete an item and confirm permanent removal
preconditions: An item exists in a known category

steps.action: Locate the target item and click its delete icon
steps.expected_result: A confirmation prompt appears asking to confirm deletion

steps.action: Click "Delete" to confirm
steps.expected_result: The confirmation closes and the item no longer appears in the list

steps.action: Refresh the page
steps.expected_result: The deleted item does not reappear, confirming the deletion persisted

postconditions: Other items in the same category remain unaffected

requirement: As a user, I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my shopping lists.

test_cases.title: Log in successfully with valid credentials
preconditions: A registered account exists with a known email and password
test_data: Password: correct password for that account

steps.action: Navigate to the login page
steps.expected_result: Email and password fields are visible and empty

steps.action: Enter the valid email and password from test data
steps.expected_result: Both fields accept the input; password is masked

steps.action: Click "Sign in"
steps.expected_result: User is redirected to the dashboard within a few seconds

steps.action: Verify the dashboard displays the logged-in user's data
steps.expected_result: Categories and items belonging to that account are shown, not another account's data

postconditions: Session remains active on subsequent navigation without re-prompting login

requirement: As a user, I want to search my items so that I can quickly find something without scrolling.

test_cases.title: Search narrows the item list to matching results
preconditions: A category contains at least 5 items with distinct names
test_data: Search term: a substring matching exactly one item's name

steps.action: Open the category containing the test items
steps.expected_result: All items in the category are listed

steps.action: Type the search term into the search box
steps.expected_result: The list updates as text is entered, without requiring a page reload

steps.action: Verify the filtered results
steps.expected_result: Only the item matching the search term is shown; all others are hidden

steps.action: Clear the search box
steps.expected_result: The full original item list is restored
